key.name: primary-limit
key.description: "highest" is the limit closest to used up; "session" and "weekly" fall back to it.

key.name: hide-unavailable
key.summary: Hide a provider that has no figure to show
key.description: A provider that is signed out, expired or unreadable has no tab, and the button is hidden while none has a figure. They are still read.

key.name: renew-login
key.summary: Renew an expired login by running the provider's tool
key.description: Once per expiry, runs the tool's own claude doctor or codex doctor, which refreshes the login it stored. The extension never refreshes a token itself.

key.name: reset-format
key.summary: How a reset time is worded
key.description: "auto": a countdown under a day away, then a weekday and time. "relative": the countdown. "absolute": the time. "both": the countdown, then the time in brackets.

key.name: selected-provider
key.summary: The provider whose tab was chosen last

key.name: tab-position
key.summary: Where the provider tabs sit in the pop-up

key.name: panel-box
key.summary: Which end of the top bar the button sits at

key.name: panel-index
key.summary: Position within that end of the top bar

key.name: warn-percent
key.summary: Percentage at which a limit counts as nearly used up

key.name: critical-percent
key.summary: Percentage at which a limit counts as almost gone

key.name: notify-percent
key.summary: Percentage at which to send a notification
key.description: 0 turns notifications off. Otherwise once per limit, until that limit resets.

key.name: enabled
key.description: Off, the provider is not read and has no tab. A provider whose command-line tool is not installed is left out either way.

key.name: show-per-model
key.description: With this off only the whole-account limits are listed.

key.name: show-breakdown
key.description: A line naming which of the provider's surfaces the period's usage came from.

key.name: show-credits
key.description: Usage bought beyond the plan's limits, when the provider reports it.
